items.name:
This 6-week program is designed for intermediate-level boulderers (V5-V8 or 6C-7B+) that are looking to incorporate a mixture of technique-focused climbing drills and strength work.  This program was built in collaboration with Emil Abrahamsson as part of his 3-part training series on going from V0 to V15 and looks to address the skills that he sees as most important for bouldering specialists.  

This program is best suited for climbers that wish to train 3 days per week.  During the first week of the program athletes will assess their current finger strength and max pull-ups. 

A suggested weekly schedule for the program is:

Session 1: Max Hangs & Lock-off Training
Session 2: Dyno Training & Weighted Pull-ups
Session 3: Campus Bouldering

Climbers that prefer to perform Edge Lifts should use the Edge Lift protocol instead of the One-arm Max Hang.

A suggested weekly schedule for the program is:

Session 1: One-arm Max Hangs & Hard Projecting
Session 2: Campus Latch & Campus Bouldering
Session 3: Volume Session & Weighted Pull-ups

items.name:
This 6-week program is designed for sport climbers with some experience with structured training that would like to build a foundation of power endurance to prepare for pumpy sport climbs. The template is designed to be split across three training days per week.  

The first training day can be completed at a boulder wall and should consist of the Warm Up, followed by either Boulder Intervals (weeks 1 & 2), Style Triad (Weeks 3 & 6), or Broken Quarters (weeks 4 & 5).  

The second training day will consist of the Route Warm Up Protocol followed by Route Pyramids (except for week 3).  

The third training day will consist of the Finger Strength Testing Session on week 1 and then on the remaining weeks will consist of 7:3s 50-60% repeaters.  The repeaters workouts can be done after max strength fingerboarding, but should not be done before strength training.  

Additional sessions can be added to this plan to maintain base endurance or strength & power.

The third training day will consist of the Finger Strength Testing Session on week 1 and then on the remaining weeks will consist of 7:3s 50-60% repeaters.  The repeaters workouts can be done after max strength fingerboarding, but should not be done before strength training.  

Additional sessions can be added to this plan to maintain base endurance or strength & power.
